description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing it.
When Bloodflow Connoisseur dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Bloodflow Connoisseur didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Bloodflow Connoisseur from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Bloodflow Connoisseur from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Bloodflow Connoisseur is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
